body:
# Cobblemon Ascendant
### Catch, Battle, and Ascend.

The **official client modpack** for the **Cobblemon Ascendant** server. Install it, hit play, and you're in — the server's already in your multiplayer list and the resource pack auto-applies.

> 🌐 **Server IP:** `play.cobblemonascendant.gg`
> 💬 **Discord:** [Discord](https://discord.gg/uDtGV7pYaW)
 · 🔗 **Website:** [cobblemonascendant.gg](https://cobblemonascendant.gg/)

---

## What is Cobblemon Ascendant?
A handcrafted Cobblemon survival server built around catching, battling, and climbing to the top. Every Pokémon is catchable, legendaries are rare and *earned*, and a deep custom economy keeps the grind rewarding.

## ✨ Server Features
- **⭐ King of the hill pvp legendary spawns** — king-of-the-hill legendary & shiny hunts. Hold the marked zone for 5 minutes against everyone else to claim a rare Pokémon. PvP is on.
- **📕 The Full Pokédex** — every species modeled and catchable, spread across the custom biomes of *Oh The Biomes We've Gone*.
- **🎰 Pokéspinner** — a gacha spinner with a pity system. One of only two ways to land a legendary.
- **🏆 Gyms & Elite Four** — curated leaders with real teams to battle for rewards.
- **🗼 Battle Tower** — an endless, scaling PvE climb with a monthly leaderboard.
- **⛏️ Idle Economy** — Stations put your boxed Pokémon to work earning money. Plus daily rewards, AFK perks, quests, crates, and a player auction house.
- **⚔️ Clans & PvP** — form a clan, compete in bi-weekly seasons, and risk it all in the full-loot Resource World.
- **💎 Mega Evolution** — Mega Showdown
- **🤝 Fair play** — no pay-to-win Pokémon. Earn your way to the top.

## 🚀 How to Join
1. **Install** this modpack.
2. **Launch** it.
3. Click **Cobblemon Ascendant**
